ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across 95% of the visible surface with a very low ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels localized to specific scar patterns.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark pigmentation across the entire surface; isolated high-contrast white focal points located in the central-right lobe and extreme left tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a wide obtuse angle and moderate depth in the vertical pixel plane.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern with significant amplitude variations at the distal tips, transitioning to lower-amplitude peaks along the mid-lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edge of both lobes tapering towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed across the mid-right lobe area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct set of at least four white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing diagonally on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme morphological irregularity at the tips of both lobes, particularly a shredded or jagged appearance on the left tip indicating significant prior tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'shredded' profile of the far left lobe tip with multiple protruding jagged segments.
